C3.cause: hooksForProvider generated only injection-point subscriptions. It omitted the PostModelSwitch observer required whenever compiled entries need model, so the runtime never received the event that updates the persisted model.

implementation_fix.change: Subscribe to PostModelSwitch only when a Claude entry needs model. Await its state write, preserving neutral observer output. Removing the final model dependency removes the subscription during normal trust/recompile.
implementation_fix.before_fix: The installed observer regression and the system-template, tool-template and model-condition cases failed; static-only and unrelated-tool cases passed.
implementation_fix.coverage: Install-generated argv through the actual CLI entry, startup model, neutral switch output, next-prompt refresh, subsequent dedup, synchronous observer, conditional subscription and removal after trust.
